boards.heading: The wait setting and the label gate
boards.intro: A batch takes a text file only once its labels are in: suggested, confirmed, or the file’s own tags. A file still being labeled, or whose suggestion failed, stays in the queue with a Next batch pill and goes in a later batch. A failed suggestion is retried by itself up to 3 times; after that the row waits for you (Retry, + Add, or Send without labels). Files the AI can’t label (PDFs, images) and every file when queue labeling is off go in as before. Wait before picking up a file is set in hours and minutes, 0 (no wait) to 24 hours.

boards.title: Queue · folders, Google Docs, Refresh and the queue check
boards.heading: Queue · folders, Google Docs, Refresh
boards.intro: The queue now lists what is really in the queue folder. Refresh (next to Reveal in Finder) re-syncs at once, and the core checks by itself every 5 minutes (Settings → Batching) and when the window opens. A folder is one queue item: folder icon, name, “12 files · 3 folders”, total size; it expands to a read-only tree; when processed, its structure goes to the AI as context next to the files. A .gdoc is only a pointer to a Google Doc, so its content can’t be read here: it shows as a Google Doc row, “needs Google Drive access”, with a Waiting pill and a short hint, and it is not processed. Fetching from Google Drive is being designed separately.
